integrity: Proof and exact-rational independent finite-tree tests are included. The novelty comparison is based on material inspected and relevant searches, not proof of worldwide uniqueness. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: One completed post on a fixed rooted directed arborescence with unique-parent exposure, independent node broadcast decisions, deterministic starting opinions, and fixed FJC-style affine updates. The all-order law is not asserted for multiple incoming exposure parents, adaptive diffusion, or an unconditioned random starting opinion state. Standard tree-percolation moment methods are not claimed as new.
title: Exact uncertainty law and variance cancellation for rooted cascade opinions
